INSERT INTO crm_connections (
            organization_id,
            user_id,
            provider,
            status,
            disconnected_at,
            last_error_code,
            last_error_message,
            updated_at
         )
         VALUES ($1, $2, 'SALESFORCE', 'DISCONNECTED', now(), NULL, NULL, now())
         ON CONFLICT (user_id, provider)
         DO UPDATE
            SET organization_id = EXCLUDED.organization_id,
                status = 'DISCONNECTED',
                disconnected_at = now(),
                last_error_code = NULL,
                last_error_message = NULL,
                updated_at = now()
         RETURNING
            id,
            organization_id,
            user_id,
            provider::text AS "provider!",
            status::text AS "status!",
            connected_at,
            disconnected_at,
            last_error_code,
            last_error_message
